// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/modules/projects: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export interface AddProjectPluginInput {
    project_id: string;
    plugin_id: ProjectPluginId;
    actor_id: string;
}

export interface AddWorkspaceProjectInput {
    canonical_path: string;
    project_id: string;
    actor_id: string;
    user_confirmed: boolean;
}

export interface ChangeDirectoriesInput {
    project_id: string;
    actor_id: string;
    change: DirectoryChange;
    expected_revision: string;
}

export interface CreateProjectInput {
    display_name: string;
    actor_id: string;
}

export interface DeleteProjectInput {
    project_id: string;
    actor_id: string;
    delete_confirmed: boolean;
    idempotency_key: string;
    output_files?: "keep" | "delete";
}

export type DirectoryChange = {
    kind: "add_input";
    workspace_path: string;
} | {
    kind: "remove_input";
    workspace_id: string;
} | {
    kind: "set_output";
    target: DirectoryTarget;
} | {
    kind: "repair";
    workspace_id: string;
    workspace_path: string;
} | {
    kind: "map_source";
    source_workspace_id: string;
    target: DirectoryTarget;
} | {
    kind: "unmap_source";
    source_workspace_id: string;
} | {
    kind: "set_instructions";
    off: boolean;
};

export type DirectoryRole = "input" | "output";

export type DirectoryTarget = {
    workspace_id: string;
} | {
    workspace_path: string;
} | {
    default_output: true;
};

export declare const PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PROVIDER_ID = "system.project-workspaces";

export interface ProjectDataDeclaration {
    readonly label: string | TextRef;
    readonly order?: number;
    purge(homeDirectory: string, projectId: string): void | Promise<void>;
}

export interface ProjectDeletionReceipt {
    deletion_id: string;
    project_id: string;
    display_name: string;
    actor_id: string;
    deleted_binding_count: number;
    cleanup_state: "complete" | "pending";
    cleanup_error: string | null;
    deleted_at: string;
    cleaned_at: string | null;
}

export interface ProjectDeletionRecord extends ProjectDeletionReceipt {
    owner_steps: ProjectDeletionStep[];
}

export interface ProjectDeletionResult {
    deletion: ProjectDeletionRecord;
    replayed: boolean;
    kept_output_directory?: string;
}

export interface ProjectDeletionStep {
    owner_id: string;
    state: "pending" | "complete";
    error: string | null;
    updated_at: string;
}

export interface ProjectDirectories {
    project_id: string;
    directories: ProjectDirectory[];
    source_links: {
        source_workspace_id: string;
        workspace_id: string;
    }[];
    instructions: {
        off: boolean;
        trusted: boolean;
    };
    revision: string;
}

export interface ProjectDirectory extends ProjectWorkspaceRef {
    roles: DirectoryRole[];
    state: "ok" | "missing";
}

export interface ProjectDirectoryPage {
    default_output_id: string;
    default_output_made: boolean;
    source_kinds: Record<string, SourceKind>;
}

export type ProjectPluginId = string;

export interface ProjectPluginMembership {
    plugins: ProjectPluginId[];
    hidden: ProjectPluginId[];
}

export interface ProjectPluginRegistry {
    has(pluginId: ProjectPluginId): boolean;
    initial?(): readonly ProjectPluginId[];
    companions(pluginId: ProjectPluginId): readonly ProjectPluginId[];
    isPersonal?(pluginId: ProjectPluginId): boolean;
    alwaysOn?(): readonly ProjectPluginId[];
}

export interface ProjectRecord {
    spaceId?: string;
    project_id: string;
    display_name: string;
    database_path: string;
    source: "created";
    data_class: "user" | "regenerable_demo";
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
}

export interface ProjectSelection {
    project_id: string;
    display_name: string;
}

export interface ProjectWorkspaceDirectoryRecord extends ProjectWorkspaceRef {
    project_ids: string[];
    person_project_ids: string[];
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
}

export interface ProjectWorkspaceMembership {
    membership_id: string;
    workspace_id: string;
    workspace_name: string;
    realpath_verified: boolean;
    project_id: string;
    roles: DirectoryRole[];
    bound_by: string;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
}

export interface ProjectWorkspaceRef {
    workspace_id: string;
    canonical_path: string;
    realpath_verified: boolean;
    display_name: string;
}

export interface ProjectsApplicationApi {
    query: ProjectsQueryApi;
    commands: ProjectsCommandApi;
}

export interface ProjectsCommandApi {
    addProjectPlugin(input: AddProjectPluginInput): ProjectPluginId[];
    removeProjectPlugin(input: RemoveProjectPluginInput): ProjectPluginMembership;
    setProjectPlugin(projectId: string, actorId: string, input: SetProjectPluginInput): VersionedProjectPluginMembership;
    renameProject(projectId: string, displayName: string, actorId: string, expectedDisplayName: string): ProjectRecord;
    addWorkspaceProject(input: AddWorkspaceProjectInput): ProjectWorkspaceDirectoryRecord;
    changeDirectories(input: ChangeDirectoriesInput): ProjectDirectories;
}

export interface ProjectsQueryApi {
    wasProjectPluginRemoved(projectId: string, pluginId: ProjectPluginId): boolean;
    storedProjectPluginMembership(projectId: string): ProjectPluginMembership;
    projectPluginMembership(projectId: string): ProjectPluginMembership;
    projectPluginMembershipWithRevision(projectId: string): VersionedProjectPluginMembership;
    listProjectPlugins(projectId: string): ProjectPluginId[];
    listHiddenPlugins(projectId: string): ProjectPluginId[];
    listProjects(): ProjectRecord[];
    getProject(projectId: string): ProjectRecord;
    selections(): ProjectSelection[];
    listWorkspaceMemberships(): ProjectWorkspaceMembership[];
    listWorkspaceDirectory(projectId?: string): ProjectWorkspaceDirectoryRecord[];
    projectDirectories(projectId: string): ProjectDirectories;
    outputDirectory(projectId: string): ProjectWorkspaceRef;
    defaultOutputDirectoryId(projectId: string): string;
    workspaceIdAt(canonicalPath: string): string | null;
    workspaceProjectSelections(workspaceId: string): ProjectSelection[];
    listProjectDeletions(): ProjectDeletionRecord[];
}

export interface RemoveProjectPluginInput {
    project_id: string;
    plugin_id: ProjectPluginId;
    actor_id: string;
}

export interface RunDirectories {
    directories_revision: string;
    output: string;
    inputs: string[];
    execution: {
        kind: "output";
    } | {
        kind: "worktree";
        worktree_id: string;
    };
}

export interface SetProjectPluginInput {
    plugin_id: ProjectPluginId;
    enabled: boolean;
    expected_revision: string;
}

export type SourceKind = "folder" | "former_default_output" | "other_default_output";

export interface VersionedProjectPluginMembership extends ProjectPluginMembership {
    revision: string;
}

export declare const projectDirectoryActions: {
    get: ActionDefinition<Record<string, never>, ProjectDirectories>;
    addInput: ActionDefinition<{
        workspace_path: string;
    } & {
        expected_revision: string;
    }, ProjectDirectories>;
    removeInput: ActionDefinition<{
        workspace_id: string;
    } & {
        expected_revision: string;
    }, ProjectDirectories>;
    setOutput: ActionDefinition<DirectoryTarget & {
        expected_revision: string;
    }, ProjectDirectories>;
    repair: ActionDefinition<{
        workspace_id: string;
        workspace_path: string;
    } & {
        expected_revision: string;
    }, ProjectDirectories>;
    mapSource: ActionDefinition<({
        source_workspace_id: string;
    } & DirectoryTarget) & {
        expected_revision: string;
    }, ProjectDirectories>;
    setInstructions: ActionDefinition<{
        off: boolean;
    } & {
        expected_revision: string;
    }, ProjectDirectories>;
    unmapSource: ActionDefinition<{
        source_workspace_id: string;
    } & {
        expected_revision: string;
    }, ProjectDirectories>;
};
